::: {.about-body}

::: {.lead-text}
I turn complex data into clear, honest stories, especially when the findings
matter to people who don't work with data every day.
:::

I'm a Master of Business Analytics student at Monash University. Before Monash,
I completed a Bachelor of Business Administration (Business Analytics), which
taught me that even the best analysis is of little use if nobody understands it.
